neighbours.label: the word 'linked' or 'cited' in the sense of one document or profile referring to another (Works Cited, cited in, the linked essays, linkedin)
fire: Please add a Works Cited page at the end of your paper.
His research is widely cited in later studies of the brain.
Follow him on linkedin to see his latest job updates.
The linked article explains how the tax works in detail.
Check each source that is cited in the second chapter.
Every paper must include a Works Cited section in MLA style.
See the linked page for a full list of the rules.
Her profile on linkedin lists three former employers.
quiet: Please add a Table of Contents page at the start of your paper.
His research is widely known in later studies of the brain.
Follow him on the trail to see the old mine shaft.
The short article explains how the tax works in detail.
Check each source that is stored in the second cabinet.
Every paper must include a Title section in large type.
See the next page for a full list of the rules.
Her resume on paper lists three former employers.

notes: Card: ' linked' x6, ' cited' x3, ' in' x2, ' registered' x2, 'ited', 'References'. Probes: linkedin 1.111, 'Works Cited' 0.853, 'works cited' 0.683, 'linked essays' 0.369; 'Shopping list' 0.011, 'short essays' 0.012. Near misses use other words in the same frames.
